name: Tanomiya Moko
source:
Hobbies: Collecting and building military models
Likes: All kinds of military stuff, the smell of adhesive
Dislikes: Enamel paint

A member of the modeling club who is very enthusiastic about her hobbies and likes. Moko is sad because her club is on the verge of being disbanded due to the lack of members. Because of that and how none of the girls want to join her club, she tries her hardest to recruit [url=/c54699]Seita[/url] - whom she calls Hiriya-dono - into becoming a member.
